answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy makes every identity post a refundable bond, and the agent that vouches for it shares slashing liability. Behavior is split by a reputation prism into independent axes such as delivery, uptime and dispute rate, so faking one axis cannot lift the rest. A randomness beacon samples finished tasks for later audit; any bond whose delta between claimed and verified work exceeds tolerance is slashed along with its voucher. Forging N identities therefore costs N bonds plus quadratic vouching exposure, while each fake earns only linear rewards.
